items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Did you know Peck in Texas? Yes, I met Peck.

ctx.x: And he told me about playing around East Texas and how he went on from there to do everything.
I liked Tim very, very much. He was one fine fellow. Mm-hmm. Still is. Oh, yeah. Tim was a very good friend of Peck Kelly's.
Mm-hmm. Well, they finally put out a record of Peck. I haven't heard it yet.
